title: Mortgage demand turns lower, as interest rates shoot back up to the highest level in three weeks
summary: Recent data indicates a significant increase in mortgage rates, which have reached their highest point in three weeks. This surge has led to a noticeable decline in demand for both mortgage refinances and home purchase loans. The economic implications of rising interest rates are becoming increasingly evident as potential homebuyers and those looking to refinance reconsider their options in the current financial landscape.
shadowing: Mortgage rates moved sharply higher last week.
Demand for mortgage refinances has dropped.
Home purchase loans are also affected.
Rates hit the highest in three weeks.
The economic implications are becoming evident.
